slacs.description: SLACS lenses (Bolton et al. 2008 Table 4; Auger et al. 2009, SLACS IX): all 85 Auger+2009 grade-A lenses except the SWELLS disk deflectors (-> swells) and J1618+4353 (a single 420 s SNAP frame, below the exposure gate). 76 lenses, 3 of them with no usable HST imaging (J0109+1500, J0405-0455, J1259+6134). `etherington_gold` marks the 38 graded Gold by Etherington et al. 2022 (MNRAS 517, 3275). The default --sample. Merged on 2026-11-02 from slacs_prime, slacs_complex, slacs_sparse, slacs_late and slacs_multi (which on 2026-10-29 replaced slacs_gold and slacs_other); each lens's `note` keeps its Bolton class and Auger morphology.

swells.description: SWELLS lenses (Treu et al. 2011; Brewer et al. 2012): high-inclination disk deflectors, lenticular to late-type spiral. Today the eight that SLACS also found: J0841+3824, J1029+0420, J1032+5322 (Etherington Gold), J0955+0101, J1251-0208, J2141-0001, J1103+5322 (Bolton U-S-A) and J1313+0506 (Bolton L-S-B, Auger grade A). The SWELLS-only grade-A lenses (GO-11978, GO-12292) are not yet reduced.

gallery.description: BELLS GALLERY (HST proposals 14189, 16734), WFC3/UVIS multi-band (F438W, F606W, F814W; the F225W/F275W products were found unusable for lens science and deleted 2026-09-29). Restricted to Shu et al. 2016 Table 1 classification E-S-A (early-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging) — L-S-X, E-M-A, E-S-X, and E-S-M systems excluded. mast_target holds each lens's full SDSS coordinate designation, the MAST target name for this sample (see 'Non-standard MAST target names' in AGENTS.md). Reduced with drizzle_wfc3_uvis.py.

bells.description: BELLS (Brownstein et al. 2012), HST GO-12209, ACS/WFC F814W (~2200-2400 s per lens). Restricted to Brownstein et al. 2012 Table 3 classification E-S-A or L-S-A (early- or late-type, single lens, clear multiple imaging; 21 + 3), the same rule as the non-Gold SLACS lenses (originally the slacs_other sample). J1522+2910 (E-M-A) and all grade B/C/X systems excluded. Disjoint from gallery by construction (BELLS sources are [OII]/Hb/[OIII] emitters at z_s < 1.5). MAST target names are the short SDSS<LENS> form, so no mast_target overrides. Reduced, masked and positions marked (2026-10-22). J1337+3620 was REMOVED 2026-10-14: a multi-deflector system -- a companion 5.24" away (SDSS z_phot 0.59+/-0.10 vs z_lens 0.564), with 35-50% of the deflector's light, would need its own mass component. J1349+3612 was REMOVED 2026-10-14: a multi-deflector system -- a same-redshift companion 3.9" away (DESI z=0.4412 vs z_lens 0.4396, dv~330 km/s), ~80% of the deflector's light; Tan+2024 fits external shear 0.17. J1542+1629 was REMOVED 2026-10-22: its contaminant mask (the masked neighbouring galaxy) reaches in to 1.08", past theta_E = 1.04", so the mask cuts into the Einstein-ring annulus.

J0747+4448.category_reason: bright-star diffraction spikes masked; two nearby galaxies

dinos.description: SL2S lenses with deep WFC3/UVIS F475X from GO-17130 (Project Dinos II, Sheu et al. 2025), with or without a second band (WFPC2 F606W GO-11289, ACS F814W GO-10876, or the GO-11588 F600LP snapshot). F475X is restricted to GO-17130 (proposals quirk). Merged on 2026-11-02 from sl2s_dinos_a (9, with a second band) and sl2s_dinos_x (11, F475X the only deep band). J0233-0438 (2026-10-14, failed visits) and J0848-0351 (2026-10-24, not a grade-A lens) were removed; see AGENTS.md *SL2S samples*.

Project Dinos II lens (Sheu+2025, GO-17130 F475X); first HST imaging. stamp_box 20 (2026-10-14): F475X is its only band and the lensed images outshine the deflector there; the 100 px search centred the stamp on a compact knot 2.57" from the deflector, outside the Einstein ring. 20 px = +/-0.4" about the Gavazzi+14 position, inside which the only peak is the deflector.
